Text: 🚀 Global Launch: Jarvix, Your Context OS is now live! 

Meet the next generation of personalized AI built around your context, your taste, and your way of thinking.

#JarvixOS transforms how you work with AI by understanding your patterns, carrying your context across agents, and helping you move from ideas to action.

Step into a new era of AI collaboration:
• Discover your AI-native archetype
• Build your personal AI model from your evolving AI interactions
• Never start from zero - your context moves with you across sessions
• Coordinate Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Hermes, OpenClaw, and more as one connected AI team.
• Turn insights into your next move, with you always in control

Instead of adapting yourself to every agent, @Jarvixdotlive carries the context you choose, helps you understand what it reveals, and brings the right agents together when you decide to act.

Your AI tools shouldn’t work like separate assistants.
They should work like one team.

That’s the future of AI:
Not more agents. One shared context. One Jarvix.
